must_catch.item: The outcome carries the online-only scope note
The decision-maker contradiction is surfaced (Maya chose, Greg decided)
Customer language is marked Not covered
'A third of the churn' is labeled unverified or opinion
Speaker 2 is treated as the AE

fails: Message insight claims the 'average uplift' (M4) and 'study-backed ROI' (M6) claims 'are exactly what did not move them'. The transcript never says a study-backed ROI claim (or a specific average-uplift claim) was pitched, so this result is unsupported.
data.notes: The report got the core right: Won is scoped to online memberships, with the front desk still on Global and phase two undated. It also surfaced the Maya-chose / Greg-decided contradiction and marked customer language as not covered. It missed the key's rep takeaway that the front desk is a live competitive deal, not a done one. Its 'staged path / front desks can stay where they are' messaging concedes in-store ground instead of making a live in-studio reader demo the proof to build for phase two. It also mislabels the answered decider question as 'dodged'.
